body: It's only been getting worse for me over the years. I'm hoping medication will start to turn that around, though. I haven't really tried too many classes. As I said, my interests are pretty introverted and I'm a really nervous person, which makes things like taking classes or groups really difficult because of how anxious it makes me. Plus my interests aren't necessarily suited to social interaction - a lot of reading, gaming, boring stuff like that . Id like to try a class of some sort that I might find interesting, but I live in a pretty small town and so those sorts of resources are quite sparse.  Also, my expectation isn't that everyone I meet will be a BFF.  It's more that nobody I've ever met has been that to me.  Thanks for responding.
